title: Spade Agent Format 1.0: A scenario test

name.description: What the scenario shows, in a few words.

given.description: What starts the run: a message, a trigger or a call, one of them.

model.description: The scripted model: one step per model call; the last step only says something.

tools.description: Fake results by tool name, for tools that would reach outside.

message.description: The person writes this to the bot.

trigger.description: One of the package's schedule, event or webhook triggers fires, by name.

call.description: Another bot of the person's calls one of the package's contracts (ADR 0200 §7).

GivenCall.description: A contract call a scenario gives the bot.

contract.description: One of the package's contracts, by name.

input.description: The call's input, which fits the contract's input schema.

from.description: The calling bot's name; "Another bot" when unset.

Step.description: One answer of the scripted model.

calls.description: The tool calls it makes after saying it.

ScriptedCall.description: A tool call the scripted model makes.

Answers.description: A fake tool's answers: one, or a list taken in turn (the last repeats).

calls.description: Tools that ran, in this order (others may run between them).

not_called.description: Tools that must not have run.

effects.description:
Effects the agent asked for (`network`, `publish`, `send_as_person`, …), as the gate read
its calls.

refused.description: Tools the gate refused, because the package didn't declare their effect.

cards.description: Cards shown, each by words in its title.

reply_contains.description: Words the agent's reply contains, case aside.

output.description:
With `given.call`: fields the call's output holds, each with this value. The output is
always checked against the contract's schema.
